system: REFINING MINIGAME (lockpicking-style cylinder/tumbler alignment) — Game-1-modular/Crafting-subdisciplines/refining.py + difficulty/reward/tag/rarity support modules + game_engine integration/rendering
summary: Refining is a sequential timing minigame: N cylinders spin; the player presses SPACE when the rotating pick indicator is inside a fixed green arc at the top (target angle 0°). Each hit freezes that cylinder and advances to the next; aligning all cylinders before the timer runs out (with limited misses) succeeds. Difficulty is derived from recipe materials — points = Σ(tier×qty) × diversity(1+0.1/extra unique) × station(1+0.5×tier) — linearly interpolated into cylinder count (3-12), timing window (0.05-0.01s), rotation speed (1.0-4.0 rev/s), time limit (45-15s), allowed failures (2-0). Success outputs a MATERIAL (no stats) whose rarity is upgraded by total input quantity (4/16/64/256 → +1..+4 tiers), optionally by an alloyQuality title proc scaled by minigame performance, and by probabilistic recipe-tag procs (smelting/crushing/grinding/purifying/alloying). Failure destroys 30-90% of inputs scaled by difficulty. INT stat slows rotation and extends time WITHOUT shrinking the acceptance window (window is frozen at init). An instant-craft path (no minigame) exists with the same rarity/tag pipeline minus the title proc.

Fail states: timer hits 0 ('Time's up!') or misses exceed allowed_failures ('Too many failed attempts!') (refining.py:216-217, 277-278)
All-or-nothing: success only when every cylinder aligned; triggered inside handle_attempt on last alignment (refining.py:267-269)
Failure loses 30-90% of recipe input materials, shown as loss % (reward_calculator.py:497-519; game_engine.py:8944-8951)
HUD: tumbler progress dots (green done / pulsing current / dim pending), attempts remaining, countdown timer, brass lock visualization 1000x700 right-aligned overlay (game_engine.py:10044-10221)
Green target arc rendered at top of wheel (angles offset -90° so 0°=top); rotating pick line + triangular tip (game_engine.py:10317-10378)

Startup metadata overlay shows Refining, difficulty tier/points, time limit, 'max_bonus' 1.0+points*0.012, Tumblers, Attempts; blocks minigame update until dismissed (game_engine.py:10049-10065, 8556-8558)

On success: output material added to inventory with rarity; notification 'Crafted <Rarity> <Name> xQ'; bonus messages for tag procs ('+N bonus yield!', 'Quality upgrade: X → Y!') and alloy proc log (refining.py:722, 742-763; game_engine.py:9063-9099)

Instant-craft alternative (no minigame): full materials deducted, base output + quantity-rarity upgrade + tag procs, message 'Refined to <rarity>!' (refining.py:479-578)
mechanics: Difficulty points: material_points = Σ TIER_POINTS[tier]×quantity per input, min 1.0; tier from MaterialDatabase, default 1 if missing (difficulty_calculator.py:130-175)
Diversity multiplier = 1.0 + (unique_material_ids - 1) × 0.1 (difficulty_calculator.py:178-204)
Station multiplier = 1.0 + stationTier × 0.5 (T1=1.5x..T4=4.5x); tier read from recipe 'stationTierRequired' falling back to 'stationTier' (difficulty_calculator.py:348-350)
total_points = material_points × diversity_mult × station_mult (difficulty_calculator.py:352)
Parameter interpolation: normalized = clamp01((points - 1.0)/(80.0 - 1.0)); each param = easy + (hard-easy)×normalized (difficulty_calculator.py:253-283, 56-59)
REFINING_PARAMS (easy→hard): time_limit 45→15s, cylinder_count 3→12, timing_window 0.05→0.01s, rotation_speed 1.0→4.0 rev/s, allowed_failures 2→0 (difficulty_calculator.py:104-123)
Rounding: cylinder_count = max(2, round); allowed_failures = max(0, round); time_limit = int(round) (difficulty_calculator.py:357-360)
multi_speed = total_points >= 11 (rare threshold DIFFICULTY_THRESHOLDS['rare'][0]) (difficulty_calculator.py:362-363, 47-53)
Acceptance window frozen at init: base_window_degrees = timing_window × rotation_speed × 360 — computed BEFORE INT modifications, never recomputed (refining.py:112-114)

Cylinder init (start()): random start angle uniform(0,360), random direction ±1; multi_speed variation: if i%2==0 → base×0.7, elif i%3==0 → base×1.3, else base (i%2 checked first, so only odd multiples of 3 get 1.3x) (refining.py:176-199)
Per-cylinder speed = base_speed / (1.0 + speed_bonus); speed_bonus = buff_time_bonus (slows rotation, NOT extra time) (refining.py:66-69, 191)
Update per frame: time_left -= dt (timeout ends fail); feedback_timer -= dt; each un-aligned cylinder: angle += direction × speed × 360 × dt, wrapped %360 (refining.py:204-230)
Attempt check: angular distance = min(|angle-0|, 360-|angle-0|); success iff distance <= base_window_degrees × 0.625 (0.5 half-width × 1.25 grace) (refining.py:250-260)
Fail check: strictly greater — failed_attempts > allowed_failures ends game (allowed_failures=0 → first miss fails) (refining.py:274-278)

Success result payload: earned_points = aligned count, max_points = cylinder_count, attempts = current_cylinder + failed_attempts, quality_bonus (buff), difficulty_points, diversity_multiplier (refining.py:292-308)

Failure result payload: materials_lost fraction = calculate_failure_penalty(points) = 0.30 + clamp01((pts-1)/(80-1)) × 0.60, plus partial-credit earned/max points (refining.py:309-330; reward_calculator.py:497-519)

Buff wiring (engine): buff_time_bonus = max(quicken[refining], quicken[smithing]); buff_quality_bonus = max(empower, elevate); title_time = 'smithingTime' (shared), title_quality = 'refiningPrecision'; totals = buff + title passed to create_minigame (game_engine.py:4213-4261, 4280)

INT reduction applied AFTER __init__, BEFORE start(): reduction = min(INT, maxEffectiveINT=30) × reductionPerPoint=0.02; rotation_speed ×= max(0.4, 1-reduction); time_limit = int(time_limit × min(1.6, 1+reduction)); acceptance window unaffected (decoupled) (game_engine.py:4303-4362, 4391)
Engine loop: minigame.update(dt) each frame unless metadata overlay blocking; when result != None, _complete_minigame() fires immediately (non-fishing) (game_engine.py:8554-8566)

craft_with_minigame FAILURE: crafter deducts int(qty×loss) per input from the passed dict (throwaway copy), returns loss_percentage; ENGINE then consumes loss_fraction from real inventory via RecipeDatabase.consume_materials_partial (refining.py:623-642; game_engine.py:8891-8894, 8934-8951)

craft_with_minigame SUCCESS pipeline: (1) rarity uniformity of inputs → input_rarity (default 'common'); (2) output base = outputs[0] {itemId|materialId, quantity, rarity default input_rarity}, fallback legacy outputId/outputQty; (3) quantity rarity upgrade: total input qty >=4→+1, >=16→+2, >=64→+3, >=256→+4 tiers, index clamped to legendary; (4) alloyQuality title proc; (5) tag procs (refining.py:644-731)

Alloy proc: quality = int(earned/max × 100) (default 50 if missing); quality_mult = (quality-50)/50 (-1..+1); adjusted = clamp01(alloy_quality_bonus × (1+quality_mult)); if random() < adjusted and not already legendary → +1 rarity tier; alloy_quality_bonus = titles.get_total_bonus('alloyQuality') passed only from engine refining branch (refining.py:701-722; game_engine.py:8921-8930)

Tag procs (RefiningTagProcessor.calculate_final_output): process = first recipe metadata tag matching PROCESS_BONUSES else 'smelting'; independent rolls: bonus yield (smelting 15%/crushing 25%/grinding 40% → +1 qty) and quality upgrade (smelting 10% +1 / purifying 30% +1 / alloying 15% +2 tiers, ladder-clamped) (crafting_tag_processor.py:326-374, 402-504)
Rarity ladder single source of truth: ['common','uncommon','rare','epic','legendary'] (rarity_utils.py:27)

Rarity uniformity gate: all inputs must share one rarity (from items JSON, default common) else craft blocked with 'Mixed rarities' error; debug mode bypasses → 'common' (refining.py:446-477; rarity_utils.py:82-112)

Engine success path: consumes 100% recipe materials via RecipeDatabase.consume_materials (crafter does NOT deduct on minigame success), adds output via add_crafted_item_to_inventory(output_id, qty, rarity, stats={}), publishes ITEM_CRAFTED bus event, records stat_tracker crafting, awards XP int(20×station_tier×1.5), consumes 'craft' buffs for category refining (refining.py:644-645; game_engine.py:8970-9106)
Instant craft (craft_instant): deducts full input quantities from passed dict itself, same quantity-rarity upgrade + tag procs, NO alloy title proc, NO quality modifier (refining.py:479-578)

Recipe loading: recipes-refining-1.json + recipes-tag-tests.JSON; keeps recipe only if stationType=='refining' — key ABSENT defaults to 'refining', which is how the whole refining file loads (recipes use stationRequired/stationTierRequired instead) (refining.py:378-415)
Placements loaded from placements-refining-1.JSON keyed by recipeId (grid UI data) (refining.py:417-444)

Legacy fallback difficulty (only if difficulty_calculator import fails): station-tier table in get_legacy_refining_params (T1: 40s/3cyl/0.35win/0.7spd/2fail … T4: 18s/10cyl/0.10win/2.0spd/0fail/multi) plus a second, DIFFERENT hardcoded table inside refining.py (refining.py:126-164, 138-151; difficulty_calculator.py:720-747)

get_state exposes: active, cylinders (with angle/speed/direction/aligned/target_zone/last_attempt_angle), current_cylinder, aligned_count, total_cylinders, failed_attempts, allowed_failures, time_left, result, feedback_timer, timing_window, window_degrees (refining.py:332-356)

Overlay geometry: 1000x700, right-aligned -20px, vertically centered; lock center (ww/2, 300), wheel radius 130, inner radius radius-40, indicator -90° offset (0°=top) (game_engine.py:10044-10046, 10224-10225, 10305, 10341)

hazards: Visual/logic window divergence (intentional, preserve): drawn green arc = timing_window × per-cylinder EFFECTIVE speed × 360 (post-INT, post-speed-bonus, post-multi-speed) while acceptance = frozen base_window_degrees × 0.625 (pre-INT rotation_speed). INT/quicken shrink the DRAWN arc but not the acceptance zone — acceptance is more generous than visuals suggest; multi-speed cylinders draw different arc widths (game_engine.py:10318-10319 vs refining.py:114, 257-260)

get_state() never includes 'aligned_cylinders'; renderer reads state.get('aligned_cylinders', []) → always [], so ring pins never turn green (only aligned_count-driven left panel updates) AND the 'ALIGNED!' success flash branch (aligned_count>0) never fires. Bug-to-preserve or knowingly fix (refining.py:343-356; game_engine.py:10286, 10396-10406)
multi_speed branch order: i%2 tested before i%3 → all even indices (incl. 0, 6) get 0.7x; only odd multiples of 3 (3, 9, ...) get 1.3x (refining.py:183-186)

'buff_time_bonus' name is misleading for refining: it does NOT extend time; it becomes speed_bonus dividing rotation speed. INT (not buffs) extends time_limit (refining.py:66-69; game_engine.py:4358-4362)

buff_quality_bonus is stored and echoed in result['quality_bonus'] but craft_with_minigame never reads it — quality effect comes solely from earned/max alloy modifier. Dead parameter for refining (refining.py:303 vs 603-765)

Ordering dependency: INT modifies minigame.rotation_speed and .time_limit AFTER __init__ (so base_window_degrees is already frozen) and BEFORE start() (so cylinder speeds and time_left pick the changes up). Port must replicate init→modify→start sequence (game_engine.py:4303-4393; refining.py:79, 172, 191)

Failure loss double-path: crafter deducts loss from the inv dict it is given, but the engine passes a throwaway aggregation dict and then separately applies consume_materials_partial(loss_fraction) to the real inventory; loss_fraction reconstructed from result 'loss_percentage'/100 (int-truncated percent). Only the engine deduction is real (game_engine.py:8891-8894, 8944-8951; refining.py:628-641)

On minigame SUCCESS the crafter intentionally does NOT deduct materials — the engine consumes 100% via RecipeDatabase.consume_materials; craft_instant DOES deduct from the dict itself. Two different consumption contracts (refining.py:502-506 vs 644-645; game_engine.py:8973)
allowed_failures is strictly-greater tolerance: failed_attempts > allowed_failures fails, so N allowed means N misses survive, N+1st miss fails; 0 → first miss fails (refining.py:277)

Recipe filter quirk: loader keeps recipes where stationType=='refining' but defaults ABSENT key to 'refining' — the refining JSON has no stationType field at all (uses stationRequired:'refinery'), so everything loads via the default. Requiring stationType explicitly would silently load zero recipes (refining.py:403-404)

Station tier key preference for difficulty: 'stationTierRequired' first, then 'stationTier' — real recipes use stationTierRequired; the minigame's own legacy fallback reads only 'stationTier' (difficulty_calculator.py:349; refining.py:131)

difficulty_tier is computed in the params dict but never stored on RefiningMinigame; renderer getattr(minigame,'difficulty_tier','Unknown') → metadata overlay always shows 'Unknown' tier (refining.py:100-110; game_engine.py:10053)

Result modal ('Press any key to continue') is mostly vestigial: engine calls _complete_minigame immediately when result is set (non-fishing), clearing active_minigame — modal renders at most one frame (game_engine.py:8561-8566, 10412-10471)
Minigame update (and thus the countdown) is paused while the metadata intro overlay is blocking — timer decrements inside update(dt), not wall-clock (game_engine.py:8556-8558; refining.py:214-215)

Rarity uniformity check reads inputs' 'materialId' key only — an input using only 'itemId' silently reads rarity 'common' in the uniformity pass despite itemId support elsewhere (rarity_utils.py:104 vs refining.py:466)
Alloy proc quality default: missing earned/max in result defaults to 50/100 → quality 50 → multiplier 0 → base title chance unchanged (refining.py:704-706)

Debug mode (F1 infinite resources) flips rarity_system.debug_mode → uniformity always passes as 'common' and inv gets 999999 of each input; parity behavior across instant and minigame paths (game_engine.py:8903-8914; rarity_utils.py:95-97)

Two DIFFERENT legacy tier fallback tables exist (refining.py:138-151 vs difficulty_calculator.py:725-747) — both dead code unless imports fail; do not reconcile, they are unreachable in normal runtime

random.choice([1,-1]) direction and uniform(0,360) start angle per cylinder are gameplay-relevant RNG; alloy and tag procs each use independent random() rolls — success/failure of the SAME craft has non-deterministic output quantity/rarity (refining.py:180, 194; crafting_tag_processor.py:420, 442; refining.py:719)
target_zone is stored per cylinder but always 0 (top); acceptance math hardcodes wraparound distance to that stored value — keep field even though constant (refining.py:201, 250-253)

last_attempt_angle is only set after first attempt — renderer guards with 'in' check; cylinder dicts are mutated in place and shared by reference into get_state (refining.py:248, 345; game_engine.py:10381)
